tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Free. Lists the paid tools, their USDC prices on Base, the upstream x402 HTTP endpoints, and how to pay.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Paid, $0.001 USDC on Base via x402 (page-read). Fetches one public web page now and returns clean markdown or text with title, canonical URL, published time and sha256. No JavaScript execution. Fetch failures and unreadable pages are not charged. Call without payment to get the x402 requirements.

tools.name: audit_x402_seller
tools.description: Paid, $0.02 USDC on Base via x402 (agent-audit). Read-only x402 seller and agent-readiness audit of one origin: live 402 challenge per paid route, price vs catalog, llms.txt, /.well-known/x402, openapi.json, dead doc links. JSON score, findings and fixes. Grades measure protocol conformance, not leg

tools.name: check_links
tools.description: Paid, $0.01 USDC on Base via x402 (agent-audit). Checks up to 25 URLs now: status, final URL, redirects, latency, verdict ok/broken/paid(402). Call without payment to get the x402 requirements.

tools.name: quote_check
tools.description: Paid, $0.005 USDC on Base via x402 (agent-audit). Fetches the page now and reports whether the quote is really there: found_exact/found_near/partial/not_found/page_unavailable, similarity, context and page sha256. Call without payment to get the x402 requirements.

tools.name: preview_page
tools.description: Free, rate-limited (10 per hour). Title and the first 300 characters of a public page, from page-read's free preview.

tools.name: preview_audit
tools.description: Free, rate-limited (10 per hour). Audit score, grade and fail/warn counts for one origin (no findings), from agent-audit's free preview.
